name: Reversible
source:
Misaki Yoshimori, your best friend Yuuji, and you, Tatsuhiko Saito.
The three of you spent your days at school with a friendship that most would envy.

Yet, it is so easily broken.
Despite knowing your feelings for Misaki, Yuuji tells you he confessed to her, unable to go out with her if it meant lying to you.

In response to your friend's honesty you can only support him in his relationship with Misaki.
However, a small darkness is borne in your heart and mind.

Since that moment, it's as if an invisible barrier exists between the two of you, and things become more and more serious.

Feelings of guilt, more and more lies.

You become torn apart, a different person by day and night.

All this is because... you and Misaki have become addicted to the pleasures of each other.

[Description inspired by, and partially translated from, http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=420145]
translation:
吉森美咲，你最好的朋友雄二，还有你，齐藤达彦。
你们三个在学校里度过了令人羡慕的友谊。

然而，它很容易被打破。
尽管知道你对美咲的感情，雄二还是告诉你，他向她表白了，如果这意味着对你撒谎，他就无法和她出去。

为了回应你朋友的诚实，你只能支持他与美咲的关系。
然而，你的内心和思想中却笼罩着一丝小小的黑暗。

从那一刻起，两人之间就仿佛存在了一道无形的屏障，事情变得越来越严重。

愧疚感，谎言越来越多。

你变得四分五裂，白天和黑夜都变成了另一个人。

这一切都是因为……你和美咲都沉迷于彼此的快乐。

[描述灵感来自http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=420145，并部分翻译自http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=420145]
